title: brief-critic passes a 'Release content: __version__ X' criterion that the solo_execute→reviewing gate then refuses
detail: wrapped-command-naming's brief (critique PASS) required __version__ 0.260.1 and the README Action pin; advance to reviewing BLOCKED with 'sprint changes the version pin; the release owns the version bump'. scripts/release.sh bumps both. Prior trivial.md files (worktree-branch-guard) also list __version__ as sprint content, so the convention and the gate disagree. The brief-critic (or brief_lint) should flag a version/pin bump in a brief as release-owned, so it's caught at scoping, not at the reviewing gate.
